messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-4521 fired: metrics.scrape.failure on prometheus-collector-prod (severity: P1). Autopage to #eng-sre.

maria: seeing the same in Grafana - scrape failure spike across multiple exporter jobs (kafka_exporter, node_exporter). dashboards down for ~15m.

aj: acked in PD and taking primary. jumping in to triage. @maria can you paste the output of collector logs?

maria: pasting tail of prometheus-collector logs: 

```
2026-03-15T21:02:10Z ERROR scrape_manager: failed to fetch metrics from kafka_exporter: dial tcp 10.12.5.20:9100: connect: connection refused
2026-03-15T21:02:12Z WARN fanout: exporter scrape timeout exceeded for node_exporter (10.12.5.11)
2026-03-15T21:02:15Z ERROR queue: backlog length increased to 4200
```

kevin: consumer backlog looks real. kafka consumer group prometheus-fanout lag ~75k msgs per partition. likely exporter restart storm + consumer throughput issue.

sasha: any infra changes? rolling deploys? I see a k8s autoscaler event around 20:58 UTC that scaled down collector replicas to 2 (from 6) then scaled up slowly. might be correlated.

aj: good catch. scaling cadence could have left insufficient collectors during a scrape surge. quick mitigation: bump prometheus-collector replicas to 6 and increase consumer parallelism. I can run a k8s scale now, will monitor.

maria: customers reporting slow metrics in status page. need customer-impact assessment — partial, dashboards stale, alerting noisy. no direct product outages but downstream alerting suppressed. estimating 120 customers with affected dashboards.

pagerduty-bot: PD update: incident assigned to aj (primary). escalation policy: oncall->sre-lead if unacked for 8m.

aj: running: `kubectl scale deploy/prometheus-collector -n infra --replicas=6` and `kubectl rollout status deploy/prometheus-collector -n infra`.

incident-bot: Command executed by aj: scale deploy/prometheus-collector -> replicas:6. Rollout started.

kevin: restarting the prometheus consumer group to rejoin balanced partitions: `kafka-consumer-restart --group prometheus-fanout --cluster prod` (doing rolling restarts across 3 nodes).

maria: after scale up and restarts we see backlog moving down: queue 4200 -> 2100 -> 800 over 10m. grafana scrape success rate climbing to 92%.

sasha: pushed a temporary autoscaler safety patch to keep min replicas=4 for 30m so we don't scale too low during bursts.

aj: quick check on customers: alert heatmap shows ~14% of accounts have missing metric series for >10m. posting to incident status page now.

aj: PD note: will escalate to sre-lead if we see another autopage. keeping this P1 until backlog <500 and scrape success >98% for 10m.

kevin: logs showing occasional exporter OOMs on node_exporter pods, causing transient connection refused. need to follow up with infra to tune memory. created ticket INFRA-1225.

maria: also found one exporter IP (10.12.5.20) repeatedly failing healthchecks; flagged for replacement.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4521: annotated with runbook link https://redwood.prod/runbooks/prometheus-scrape-failure and incident log.

aj: monitoring metrics: backlog 800 -> 420 -> 120 over 20m. scrape success 92% -> 98.5%. moving to mitigated status in notes.

maria: posting customer-impact summary for postmortem: 120 accounts saw delayed dashboard updates, no API data loss. temporary alert suppression caused delayed downstream alerts for some customers. no billing impact.

sasha: thumbs up. we should rotate oncall and assign follow-ups: INFRA-1225 (exporter OOM), INFRA-1226 (adjust autoscaler min), SRE-567 (consumer parallelism tuning).

aj: handing off to night oncall. @oncall-rota you're up — I put remediation steps and current state in PD. will leave a runbook summary in the incident doc.

oncall-rota: Taking over. thanks @aj. I'll keep an eye for flapping and will escalate to lead if PD re-fires.

maria: leaving logs & timelines in the incident doc. final backlog 90, scrape success 99.1%. marking incident as "mitigated" in PD but keeping ticket open for follow-ups.

incident-bot: Incident PD-4521 status update: mitigated by aj; follow-ups assigned: INFRA-1225, INFRA-1226, SRE-567. Incident channel to remain open for handoff notes. :white_check_mark:

oncall-rota: acknowledged. I'll post a short timeline and update customers if we get any further regressions.

kevin: quick note for postmortem: include sequence diagram of autoscaler + scrape window. looks like scale-down during burst was the root contributor.

maria: agreed. I'll draft postmortem and ping leads for review tomorrow.

aj: thanks team. closing active mitigations. will leave channel in 10m after final checks. :thumbsup:
